provenance: SYNTHETIC -- fabricated engineering constraints on an analytic cranial vault. Exists to exercise the conformal-patch implant family on anatomy with no shaft axis. Not patient data. No clinical claim.

implant.region_note: The screws ring the defect at 30 mm, so a 16 mm margin around them spans the craniectomy and lands on intact bone all the way round.

coordinate_frame.note: The fixture mesh is already in the repo frame, so the frame is stated explicitly and the import transform is the identity.

load_cases.basis: incidental contact on the reconstructed vault -- a knock or a firm press, not weight bearing. A cranioplasty carries no body load, so this is a serviceability load, and it is the order of magnitude cranial implants are bench-loaded at, not a physiological peak.
the same contact taken as bending across the craniectomy: the device spans the defect, so the load path is through its own section rather than into bone underneath it.
